description: Use this when someone wants to see their unread customer conversations in an inbox view. Returns how many of the 50 most recently active conversations have unread messages; the view lists up to 20 with channel, status, unread count and times (no message text or customer details). Not for complete open-conversation totals.
name: show_customer_inbox

conversationsHaveMore.description: True when conversations exist beyond the 50 sampled or the 20 the view lists

unreadConversationCount.description: Conversations with unread messages among the 50 most recently active

title: Show unread conversations
